## Invitations

During the reporting period, 1874 people were invited to attend. Of these, 1039 attended, giving an attendance rate of 55.4 per cent. The figures indicate that just over half of those invited took part. This provides a straightforward measure of engagement for the outreach activity and supports comparison with attendance recorded in other reporting periods.

Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring. This seasonal pattern should be considered when reviewing the results and planning future outreach activity. It may also assist with interpreting changes in attendance that are not directly related to the invitation process.

## Contact

SMS was used as the main contact method for 1588 invitations. No reminder messages were issued: the recorded number was 0. The contact figures provide a clear record of the communication undertaken and identify an opportunity to review whether reminders could support attendance in future activity.
